method: Duerer v2 (lane-s5). Armour base as v1: categorical soft-label index master at 16x (4096), tight contours (sigma 0.32 texel, power 6, no dither blending) so camouflage patches keep native extents; lost-texel cores; native index forced at every texel centre. Region overrides, in order: (1) FX contract boxes (shock rings, bursts, debris, flames, crater): tone-group soft labels where 'near' = same class under every renderable static CLUT of the page (colour distance ignored, because the native fades are high-contrast dithers), crisp 0.42/4, blend sigma 1.0 texel, dither window 0.15..0.4, no lost-texel cores, no material; (2) 8bpp hull sub-images read as 4bpp (alt8 detector: 1-texel nibble stripes, share > 0.35 per 8x8 block, closing 1): native pass-through (nearest labels), no material, NOT HD, pending an 8bpp-mode master after the capture; (3) '13' glyph boxes: glyph lock (no material on the numeral texels) and de-stair: per-index weights (1-a)*tight + a*smooth (sigma 0.7 texel), a = staircase-corner indicator of the glyph mask blurred 0.7 texel, withdrawn wherever any native texel would lose its own index as majority (native shape guard). Material: palette-independent logD at 8x: relief 0.12 from the review-CLUT luminance, luminance detail from the lane-s5 stage-5 JuggernautXL swatches camo_paint_worn_a (0.55) + sandworn_steel_a (0.45) (raw images, centre 60 %, random Hann-windowed patches, high-pass 48 px, band-limited 1.5 px), grime 0.03; zero-mean per native index over the material area. 2B4626A3 keeps the FX contract page-wide.
render_formula: w = top-3 soft labels; base = sum_k w_k P[l_k] over labels of the dominant class; rgb = base * exp(logD) (opaque classes); class = class(P[l_0]); runtime = majority-class box-down of the 4096 render + native class stamped at floor((i+0.5)*scale); page 2B4626A3: FX contract (continuous index if ramp, energy gate)

class_validation.convention: class at pixel floor((i+0.5)*scale) of every native texel == class(CLUT[native index]); class 0 = raw 0x0000, 255 = STP, 127 = opaque

alpha_channel: categorical PSX classes (0 = raw 0x0000, 127 opaque, 255 STP), NOT opacity; exact at every native texel centre

honest_read: FX regions (3D108041 shock rings, burst, debris; BFC445B0 flames; 1168CC84 crater) no longer form dot patterns: the dithered fades become smooth tone gradients. Motion SIMULATION (twinkle-sim.json, review/twinkle-SIMULATION.png; 24-frame fly-past, bilinear no-mip from runtime-2048, Fourier motion compensation): twinkle at 3 px per native texel (minified) rings 0.079 -> 0.016, burst 0.100 -> 0.033, debris 0.133 -> 0.064, crater 0.099 -> 0.033, flames 0.064 -> 0.055 (v1 -> v2; native nearest 0.12-0.34); at 9 px per texel all v2 FX regions are 0.004-0.013 (v1 0.013-0.021, native 0.07-0.19). Whole-sprite brightness pumping is unchanged and below 2.5 %.

The price: the FX sprites are soft. At 16x the rings and bursts read as blurred glow, not as crisp grainy explosions, and local contrast drops (debris bursts -40 %, rings -18 %). Where neighbouring indices are not dithered (beta 0) the crisp contour remains, so a few hard-edged chunks sit inside the soft fades.

The '13' keeps its native shape: every native texel keeps its own index as the majority of its area (0 stroke texels below 50 %, 0 spill onto other texels, 0 centre-label and 0 export-class mismatches). The staircase diagonals (the '1' flag, the top stroke of the '3', the rotated '13') are now straight edges instead of scallops. IoU against the nearest-neighbour native glyph drops from 0.986/0.981 (v1) to 0.976/0.964, by design, because the straight edge cuts the pixel steps; max boundary deviation 0.38 texel outward / 0.53 inward.

Not everything is de-staired: steep curves of the '3' bowl (1:3 and steeper steps) and the light drop-shadow strip beside the diagonal keep small scallops, and the native-shape guard withdrew the smoothing at 4-7 texels per glyph.

The numerals carry no material. Because the straight edge passes closer to some texel centres, the glyph colour at those texel centres deviates up to 15 levels at runtime-2048 and up to 44 at runtime-1024 (v1: 0-3); classes are exact.

Stage-5 swatches: camo_paint_worn_a + sandworn_steel_a replace the Stage 1 painted_steel/gunmetal swatches. Light paint now shows faint hairline cracks and grey spatter (reads as weathered, cracked paint); dark camouflage looks almost unchanged. The material-control plate twinkles the same as v1 (0.108 vs 0.109 at 3 px per texel), dominated by the camouflage edges, not by the swatch.

8bpp hull sub-images (1F11EE57 517 blocks, BFC445B0 163, 3D108041 153 blocks of 8x8 texels) are native pass-through: 1-texel stripes, nearest, no material, explicitly NOT HD. They are pending an 8bpp-mode master once a capture gives the 8bpp draws and their 256-colour CLUT. No 8bpp content was authored.

Unchanged from v1: camouflage patches keep exact extents; 1-texel outline lines along camouflage edges are still bead chains; 2B4626A3 missiles stay soft; several review CLUTs look like wrong pairings (crimson/cyan DEECFC4B, lavender/red A132B3B3).
known_limits: All keys are predicted-static (likely pairings); import only after the stage-5 run confirms each key (validate_predicted.py confirm + gate).
One render per page; 116 further static predicted keys render from the same masters later; palette-hold keys wait for AQ-05 phase lists.

FX regions: the master's texel-centre labels are not forced there (to avoid 1-px native dots in the fades); every export still stamps the native class at every texel centre (0 mismatches). Any re-render must go through w7lib.export_rgba.

The 8bpp detector (alt8_mask: horizontal nibble alternation > 0.35 per 8x8 block, vertical < half of it, components >= 4 blocks) is a heuristic; the masked blocks are listed in the manifest (regions.blocks8).
The twinkle numbers are a SIMULATION of a bilinear no-mip fly-past, not an in-game capture.
Armour relief still comes from the review CLUT's luminance; no per-surface realism rebuild (blocked on the AQ-03 stage look captures).
